_comment: The Watch barracks + market-depth stalls, one continuous run. FIXTURE-FIRST (near_barracks -- post_tutorial_street's exact state plus gold:25, so the peddler's mini-buy is provable live without an in-script earn-grind; that mechanic is already proven elsewhere by economy_loop/inventory_loop). Proves, in order: (1) the new bread_stall (flavor/observe, pays off Pisces's pre-existing 'the bread stall raises its prices' line with a real entity); (2) the peddler's mini-buy (watch_issue_gambeson, 20g, krshia_crate's exact buy contract -- gold_changed/toast/item_gained in the same emission order economy_loop's Krshia buy already proved); (3) barracks_door's real transition (the former watch_guard flavor spot -- zero canonical QA touches confirmed by grep before this task, so removing him is a silent change; see the task report); (4) Duty Sergeant Dresk Ashgrave's talk_pool line; (5) Zevara's desk (flavor/observe -- she herself stays at the gate, zevara_intro untouched); (6) THE CELL (locked_toast, empty-v1 dressed, a quest-outcome surface for later -- same skill-less-locked-prop seam as inn_upstairs's lyonette_door); (6b) issue #81's two row-y6 discovery props (note_watch_veteran, spare_kit_crate -- both approached from directly above at y5, since the two props sit on the SAME row and block a straight sideways walk between them); (6c) the journal's new Lore section reading the just-found note back; (7) the round-trip back to the street, landing clear and open. Seed 9 for convention; fixture rng_state governs (no combat in this script).

steps._comment: Street payload (blocked_cells 112 -- see gate_district_walkthrough's own comment for the derivation: +3 walkable-through wall fix, then +3 more for the (6,19)/(15,19)/(24,19) off-grid facade fix) -- props/npcs never enter the static blocked_cells set (walls UNION the static `blocked` list only), and the grid size is untouched.
== (1) BREAD STALL == (1,3) right10 -> (11,3), up1 blocks on bread_stall (11,2) & faces it. Flavor/observe only, no buy -- pays off Pisces's pre-existing street line.

payload_contains.text: Warm bread smell over the whole row. No one's minding the stall this exact moment. The loaves aren't going anywhere without a fight.

steps._comment: == (2) PEDDLER'S MINI-BUY == (11,3) right7 -> (18,3), up1 blocks on peddler (18,2) & faces it. Buy option is index 0 (default cursor) -- press confirm immediately. Same emission order as economy_loop's Krshia buy: gold_changed BEFORE the 'Paid' toast, then item_gained.

payload_contains.speaker: Peddler
payload_contains.text: Deposit's already paid, so don't ask where it came from. Wear it in good health. More under the tarp.

steps._comment: 'That's all.' (bought node index 1) closes the conversation.

== (3) INTO THE BARRACKS == (18,3) right3 -> (21,3), right1 -> (22,3) -- open ground now (issue #53 finding 13: barracks_door moved into the facade line at (22,2), flush with the wall instead of floating a cell out in the street), up1 blocks on barracks_door (22,2) & faces it (the former watch_guard flavor cell -- zero canonical QA touches on watch_guard were found before this task's move, confirmed by grep). to_cell (2,6) lands one cell north of barracks_exit (2,7), the same offset convention as guild_door/guild_exit.

Chronology mirrors guild_door/stairs_up: transition() fires map_changed synchronously, world.gd rebuilds the field (mood/map/entities) BEFORE wi_game.gd's interact() records on_enter_accomplishment -- visited_barracks asserted AFTER the render events.

8 entities (barracks_exit, duty_sergeant, zevara_desk, cell_door, GH#70's archery_butt, issue #81's spare_kit_crate + note_watch_veteran + note_old_dread) + the PC's own sprite = 9. All three new props are ALWAYS-present (no gate) -- recruit_pell (issue #81's present_when-gated fourth addition) stays structurally absent here (missing_recruit_started never banks in this script), so it does not add to this count. This walkthrough's own route never detours to the archery_butt (archer_earn_loop.json is its dedicated canonical) -- it still renders, so the count bumps regardless of whether this run visits it.
MOOD CARD SHOT: the cool-institutional 'stern' barracks grade against the plank floor + kit-rack/briefing-table/crate dressing.

steps._comment: == (4) DUTY SERGEANT == (2,6) up2 -> (2,4), right3 -> (5,4), right1 blocks on duty_sergeant (6,4) & faces it. talk_pool fires (first talk this waking) before any conversation graph -- Dresk carries no graph v1, inert-adjacent per the DP1 Yelra/Renn/Ilvo precedent.

payload_contains.speaker: Sergeant Ashgrave
payload_contains.text: If you're here to report something, report it plain. You do the talking, the belt-slate writes it down.
Sergeant Ashgrave: If you're here to report something, report it plain. You do the talking, the belt-slate writes it down.

steps._comment: == (5) ZEVARA'S DESK == (5,4) down1 -> (5,5), right4 -> (9,5), right1 blocks on zevara_desk (10,5) & faces it. Flavor/observe only -- she herself stays at the gate (zevara_intro untouched).

payload_contains.text: Watch Captain's desk. Empty, same as every other time you've walked past it.

steps._comment: == (6) THE CELL == (9,5) up2 -> (9,3), right2 -> (11,3), right1 blocks on cell_door (12,3) & faces it. No requires_skill -- a plain interact falls through use_skill('', id) to skill_unknown + the bespoke locked_toast, the exact sewer_debris/lyonette_door seam.

payload_contains.text: Barred, and empty behind the bars. You can tell by the quiet. Whatever ends up in here hasn't happened yet.

steps._comment: == (6b) ISSUE #81 DISCOVERY PROPS == (11,3) down3 -> (11,5) (the third down step blocks on note_old_dread at (11,6) & faces it -- all three new props sit on row y6, approached from directly above since they'd otherwise block a straight sideways walk between them). Container interact grants the note (kind:parcel) + banks the flavor-only found_old_dread_note. (Relocated here from an original guild placement -- see that entity's own skeleton_scene.json comment for the scene_dynamism re-derivation.)

payload_contains.text: Got: A Ward-Charm Instruction, Copied Twice

steps._comment: up1 -> (11,4), left2 -> (9,4), down2 -> (9,5) (the second down step blocks on note_watch_veteran at (9,6) & faces it).

payload_contains.text: Got: A Watch Veteran's Letter, Unfinished

steps._comment: left5 -> (4,5), down1 blocks on spare_kit_crate (4,6) & faces it. Grants field_whetstone -- ALREADY a purchasable Krshia item (krshia_crate.json), so no new item catalog entry backs the reward itself.
== (6c) THE JOURNAL'S NEW LORE SECTION == reads back both found notes, in pickup order (note_old_dread then note_watch_veteran); field_whetstone is kind:tool, not a note, so it never appears here.

steps._comment: == (7) BACK TO THE STREET == (4,5) left2 -> (2,5), down2 -> (2,6) (the second down step blocks on barracks_exit (2,7) & faces it). Returns to street (21,3) -- open, clear of every entity (confirmed by this task's own blast-radius grep before placement).
